hooks.command: node -e "(async()=>{const root=process.env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT||process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT;if(!root){console.error('adhd-mode: no plugin root in env - CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and PLUGIN_ROOT are both unset, ruleset not injected');return}await import(require('node:url').pathToFileURL(require('node:path').join(root,'hooks','inject.mjs')).href)})().catch(e=>console.error('adhd-mode: launcher failed - '+(e&&e.message||e)))"
